rounds: A protest that changes nothing is still worth going to.
Protesters should pay towards the cost of policing their marches.
Football fans are treated far worse by the police than other crowds.
Organisers should be responsible for everything that happens at their march.
Within ten years, computers will make fairer decisions than police officers.
I would accept a camera on every street corner if crime fell.
Some causes are so important that breaking the law for them is right.
Celebrities who join protests do their cause more harm than good.
